desc: The TriStar Matrix Semi-Auto Shotgun is an all-around, dependable and durable shotgun. The Matrix is inertia driven, which requires less from the shooter as the Matrix does your work. TriStar's Matrix comes with 3 Beretta Mobil® removable chokes (IC, M, F). The front sight is bright, fiber optic sight, allowing the shooter to get on target fast. The 3" chamber allows this shotgun to take several options, making it a very versatile shotgun.
